kind: product proposal to the platform, derived from measurement
observedProblem: the market card shows the catalog version (v0.1.3) while confirming the install lands the newest published version (0.1.9) in five seconds; nothing explains the difference, and the same window that holds updates is bypassed by installs
proposal: show 目录版本 / 最新发布 / 现在可装 as three separate lines in the detail and confirm views, and show the maturity time when an update is held
grounding: dshmarket's lib/updates.js already computes latestMaturityAt and nextMaturityAt for the update-check path, so the data exists; the ask is to surface it on the install path
selfLimits: did not drive the market's update-check UI
no data on whether the mismatch makes anyone reinstall
exitOffered: if the split is deliberate and clear enough, treat the proposal as withdrawn — the post says so explicitly
